before.relationship: Same-chapter prediction and royal succession: Hazael becomes king

before.relationship: Literary regnal formula: the remaining acts in Judahs royal records
before.rationale: Joram’s closing formula refers his remaining acts to Judah’s royal daily records; Jehoshaphat’s closing formula similarly directs the reader to Judah’s royal annals. These are different kings’ notices, and the unavailable annals are not claimed as read.
